questions.question:
**Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence.**

My niece said, “I have decided to take coaching in badminton.”

options.text: My niece said she is deciding to take coaching in badminton.
My niece told that I have decided to take coaching in badminton.
My niece said that she had decided to take coaching in badminton.
My niece said she will decide to take coaching in badminton.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is** 'My niece said that she had decided to take coaching in badminton.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence in the Direct Speech is in** Present Perfect Tense**. Therefore, the sentence in the Indirect Speech should be in **Past Perfect Tense**.
 
• Present Perfect **(Subject + has/have + V3 +Object)** should be converted into Past Perfect **(Subject + had + V3 +Object)**.
 
• For example:
 
 
• He said, “I have got a new job.” (Direct Speech)
 
• He said that he had got a new job. (Indirect Speech)
 
 
 
• The following things in the sentence should change when changed from Direct speech to Indirect Speech:
 
 
• 'said' to 'said that'.
 
• 'I' to 'she'
 
• 'have decided' to 'had decided'
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: ***My niece said that she had decided to take coaching in badminton**.*
